retoken: None required. ローラ is Loran's alias and stays one token (pilot 129 DSCR); ホワイトドール is one token for both the statue (keyword 48, robot 71) and the unit nickname, same English either way.
uncertain: 黒歴史: 'Black History' vs 'Dark History'. akurasu Turn A page has BGM 'Black History' but the episode 43 title 'Shocking Dark History'; Wikipedia and Gundam Fandom lean toward Dark History. Kept Black History (proposed).
ルジャーナ: Luzianna (Wikipedia characters page, Gundam Fandom) vs Lousana (Wikipedia episode list). Kept Luzianna.

Wiki-sourced full names for characters not in akurasu (Kihel Heim, Merrybell Gadget, Lily Borjarno, Guin Sard Rhineford, Agrippa Maintainer, Sid Munzer, Phil Ackman, Keith Laijie, Fran Doll, Sweatson Stero): only Wikipedia and Gundam Fandom (fan wikis), no licensed-subtitle check possible.
白の宮殿 = White Palace is a literal rendering; Gundam Fandom calls the building Royal Palace, which the prose already glosses.
ガリア = Gaulia is only in Gundam Fandom (the game may intend Gaul/Gallia).
Gender of Corin (pilot 132): DSCR has no pronoun, settled by the source work only.
The text refers to ローラ (Guin's nickname for Loran) as a person: it is the same person as ロラン, not a separate character.
Short forms (キース, フラン, シド, リリ, フィル) could collide with other franchises' characters (e.g. Sid/Keith/Fran); none found in the Jigoku glossary, and the current library only uses them for Turn A Gundam.
akurasu Tengoku pilot database only lists Loran Cehack; every other Turn A Gundam spelling comes from the Z-era akurasu pages, which the Tengoku pages do not contradict.
